attempted_claim: Let (S^{n+1}, g_round) be the round unit sphere with 3 <= n <= 6. Let {omega_p} be the Almgren-Pitts p-width spectrum with Z_2 coefficients and let omega_1 < omega_2 be its first two distinct values. Let Sigma^n subset S^{n+1} be a closed embedded two-sided minimal hypersurface arising from Almgren-Pitts min-max with mass omega_2 and satisfying the Marques-Neves index bound for its realizing p-sweepout. Is Sigma of multiplicity one, of Jacobi-Morse index exactly n+3, and isometric to a Clifford hypersurface S^k(sqrt(k/n)) x S^{n-k}(sqrt((n-k)/n)) for some 1 <= k <= n-1?
decisive_failure: The lane could verify only conditional numerology (Clifford area ratios and index count) and the literature status of the blocking conjecture; it could not establish width identification, multiplicity one, index equality, or Clifford rigidity, and all attempted routes terminate at openly conjectural steps for 3<=n<=6.
